statements.t: "The continued execution of our Elevate to Outperform strategy gives us confidence in our 2026 outlook and our ability to achieve even stronger performance next year.

While it is too early to provide a formal outlook for 2027, we currently expect organic sales to increase mid-single digits compared to 2026 driven by incremental growth from our strategic initiatives and further positive momentum across our industrial markets.”
In particular, the statements related to expectations regarding the company's future financial performance, including information under the heading “2026 Outlook," are forward-looking.

statements.t: The Company intends to expand into new and existing markets by leveraging its collective knowledge of materials science, friction management and power transmission to create value for Timken customers.

The Company intends to grow in attractive market sectors around the world, emphasizing those spaces that are highly fragmented, demand high service and value the reliability and efficiency offered by Timken products.
The Company also targets applications that offer significant aftermarket demand, thereby providing product and services revenue throughout the equipment’s lifetime.

The Company expects 2026 full-year revenue to be up approximately 5% to 6% compared to 2025, primarily driven by higher demand across both segments, favorable pricing, the favorable impact of foreign currency rate changes and the benefit of acquisitions.

The Company's earnings are expected to be flat in 2026 compared with 2025 with higher impairment and restructuring charges, offset by the impact of favorable price/mix and higher organic sales volume.
The Company expects to generate slightly lower cash from operating activities in 2026, compared to 2025, with $540 million in 2026 compared to $554.3 million in 2025.
The Company expects capital expenditures in 2026 to be approximately 3.1% of sales.

The Company plans to fund these investments, as well as meet working capital requirements, with cash and cash equivalents and unused lines of credit within the geographic location of these investments where feasible.

In 2026, the Company expects to make contributions to its global defined benefit pension plans of approximately $33 million and to make payments of approximately $2 million to its other postretirement benefit plans.
